chapters: River paths, vineyards and canals carry the route east through France.
Through southern Germany to Munich, then long days towards the Austrian mountains.
Sharp climbs, streams and narrow ridges, then a descent down empty ski slopes after dark.
Rain and wooded climbs give way to canal paths, flat farmland and the Croatian plain.
River paths and muddy ground lead to Belgrade, with monuments photographed along the way.
Across the Bulgarian border, over the final hills and into Sofia.
moments: The route followed the river for about twenty kilometres, then continued through Château-Thierry onto wooded paths.
Cliff faces flanked the path, with blue flies moving between them. Witchi Tai To played on this section.
A sharp climb and a small waterfall marked the start of Austria, with mountains surrounding the road.
Streams, scrambles and narrow ridges crossed the Tauern at about 2,500 metres. The descent continued down empty ski slopes after dark.
More than fifty kilometres through drizzle, waterlogged paths and fog ended with a steep wooded climb after dark.
Trains bridged unsafe main-road sections before a walk across flat farmland to Osijek. The gaps in the recordings remain visible on the map.
An aircraft mounted above a plinth appears in the photographs from the approach to Belgrade.
A pale obelisk topped by a dark flame-shaped sculpture stands in the park, photographed on the day the route reached Belgrade.
The border crossing left Sofia one day away. The final roads through the Bulgarian hills brought the Paris-to-Sofia trek to its end.
